text:
Avery L.: kicking off Vectora-13B presales thread. Customer wants to proof the model for chat + doc-summarization. Two quick asks from AE: (1) compatibility check (tokenizer, kv-cache, quant variants, streaming), (2) clear POC pricing and a path to Dedicated if they convert. Target p95 ~200ms for short prompts.

Nina P.: I'll handle the compatibility sweep. Can you confirm expected token mix and if function-calling + streaming must be in the POC? Also, do they need Private (VPC/KMS) for the trial or just hosted?

Avery L.: Token mix: 55% <=64, 35% 65-512, 10% 512-1500. They want streaming in POC; function-calling is a nice-to-have but should be tested. Private is preferred for security team involvement; KMS likely.

Omar T.: Quick note: Vectora uses SentencePiece + a small set of custom control tokens and unusual BOS/CLS behavior in a few checkpoints. If the customer's checkpoint variant diverges we can either ship a tokenizer adapter or run pre-tokenize on ingestion. KV-cache layout is standard; rotary dims are mixed (64/128) which may need kernel selection logic. I'll queue a local model-scan.

DevOpsBot: vscan job vs-20551 completed -> tokenizer: sentencepiece + 2 custom tokens (adapter recommended); rotary dims: mixed 64/128 -> recommend runtime kernel tuning; quant candidates: q4_0 and q8_0 (q4_0 stable on sim); kv-cache: compatible; license: permissive open. Private deploy note: KMS required for customer-managed keys.

Nina P.: Estimate of engineering work to fully onboard: tokenizer adapter (1 dev-day), runtime kernel tune + CI (2 dev-days), produce q4_0 catalog variant + basic validation (1 dev-day). Rough ETA ~4 business days for initial support + QA.

Avery L.: Great. Pricing ask from AE: they expect ~10M tokens over a 30-day POC with streaming enabled. They may scale to Dedicated (approx target capacity 4-8 A10 GPUs). What's a quick cost compare?

Nina P.: Back-of-envelope: hosted (q4_0) for 10M tokens ~= $1.0-$1.5k + infra overhead. Dedicated: 4xA10 list ~$18k/mo, 8xA10 ~$35k/mo. We typically propose a 30-day discounted reserved trial (50% off baseline infra) + onboarding credits. I'll confirm precise numbers with pricing ops.

Omar T.: Proposed canary rollout for early validation:
```
rollout: canary
traffic: {"vectora-13b-q4_0": 10, "vectora-13b-fp16": 90}
monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate, delta_quality]
fallback: vectora-13b-fp16
```
We'll surface hallucination/regression alerts to the SRE dashboard.

Avery L.: Legal/Security: they asked for SOC2 evidence and KMS workflow. Can Legal confirm language and turnaround for KMS addendum?

LegalBot: LGTM. Opened LEG-3321 to add KMS addendum language for Private deployments and ensure SOC2 acceptance criteria are included in the SOW. Expect 2 business days to review.

Nina P.: Ops note: please upload a 500-sample prompt set and a 50-sample latency-critical subset to redwood://sales/vectora/poc/samples so I'll run quality and p95 tests. Also include any structured function-calling examples if available.

Avery L.: will send that link to customer and request SOC2 cert + KMS contact. Also scheduling a 1hr tech deep-dive demo later this week.

Omar T.: INF-4922 opened for runtime kernel tuning + tokenizer adapter + q4_0 build. ETA initial drop 72 hours, QA + canary 48 hours. Assigning to eng-runtime and infra.

Nina P.: Action items recap: (1) Nina -> compatibility scan + quality runs on 500 samples (ETA 1 business day). (2) Omar -> infra ticket INF-4922 + quant variant. (3) Avery -> customer checklist + request SOC2/KMS + schedule demo. (4) Legal -> LEG-3321 KMS language.

Avery L.: I'll draft a short SOW with three paths: hosted PAYG, 30-day reserved trial (discounted), Dedicated onboarding (commit). Will include acceptance criteria: p95 latency target, token budget, streaming, security deliverables.

Nina P.: Small ask: if they want function-calling in POC, call it out early so we include structured-output tests in the harness.

Avery L.: noted. Thanks team :seedling:

Omar T.: pinging eng-runtime for visibility.

DevOpsBot: reminder -> security questionnaire: https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire

Avery L.: sending checklist to customer now.

Nina P.: thumbs up.

Avery L.: closing thread for now, will post updates in INF-4922 and LEG-3321 as work progresses.
